title: Three ways to arrive
description: Three identical objects traverse equal distances with distinctly different timing.
useCase: Compare the feel of an easing choice before applying it to a real interaction.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Pale cool-grey page with three labelled rails, each starting with a small gradient token (light square, blue circle, slate square), and a white button below.
motion: Pressing the button slides all three tokens across their rails together in 900 ms, one linear, one ease-out settle and one cubic-bezier overshoot; pressing again returns them.
adapt: Each `runner` transitions `transform` over 900ms with its timing from the `curves` array (`linear`, `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`, `cubic-bezier(.2,1.45,.3,1)`); edit those strings to compare your own easings. Labels and token styles are demo content; keep the `data-still` override.
